items.title: TESHUVAH
items.quote: Fortunate is [the man] whose transgression has been forgiven, his sin covered over.
items.text: Set a personal goal of becoming free of sin through teshuvah. If you do teshuvah sincerely and without reservation, your sins will be forgiven.

items.quote: I acknowledged my sin to You and did not cover up my guilt. I resolved that I would confess my full transgression to You, Hashem.

items.title: OPPORTUNE TIME
items.quote: Therefore, [Hashem,] let every devout man pray to You at the opportune time.
items.text: If you are encountering problems in life, don’t wait until they get serious, but immediately turn to Hashem and sincerely ask Him to forgive your sins.

items.quote: But a flood of mighty waters should not reach him.

items.title: ANGELS
items.quote: You are my shelter. You protect from trouble. You surround me [with ministering angels] crying out, ‘Rescue!’.
items.text: Hashem will send His angels to protect you from your troubles if you turn to Him.

items.quote: I will instruct you and enlighten you in which path to go.
items.text: Be receptive to guidance from people with wisdom and experience.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.quote: I will instruct you and enlighten you in which path to go. I will advise you with my eye.
items.text: Be receptive to the guidance of people with wisdom and experience.

items.title: RESISTANCE
items.quote: Don’t be like a horse or mule, which is uncomprehending.
items.text: Don’t act foolishly by resisting good advice and by resisting what you know to be the proper course of action.

items.title: BITACHON
items.quote: Many things are painful to the wicked person. But he who trusts in Hashem is surrounded by lovingkindness.
items.text: Have bitachon in Hashem and you will be rewarded by gaining Hashem’s protection.

items.title: JOYFUL SONG
items.quote: You righteous people, rejoice in Hashem and be delighted. Inspire joyful song in everyone who is upright of heart.
items.text: By publicly praising Hashem through song you will inspire others to recognize Him.
